derogations.decision: Explicit derogation by Hermann for V2-PRE-1 only: the native SQLite integration check (runNativeDatabaseIntegrationCheck) is not executed in this cycle and no new infrastructure is built. The proof is recorded as NOT_EXECUTED; it is not satisfied by the future VISUAL_APPROVED marker.
derogations.residual_risk: The adapted native tool (src/infrastructure/database/integration/runNativeDatabaseIntegrationCheck.ts) is only covered by static analysis, typecheck and lint. Migration 001-007, transactional writes and reopening on a real expo-sqlite runtime (iOS and Android) remain unverified natively; a native-only defect (pragmas, foreign keys, migration on device, file reopening) would not be detected before release.
